result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off on the right edge, truncating both the image and the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container shows a proper peek/overflow hint or adjust card sizing so the truncation is intentional and clearly indicates scrollability with a visible scroll indicator or arrow.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen with no visual indicator that more content is available below.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade or scroll indicator at the bottom of the list to signal to users that more content is available by scrolling down.
